answer: The reef assignment is published and harbor records each panel. Shards are assigned from the umber graph, which means cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an farming party cannot sit on the panel that judges it. A farm of 1390 identities would post 2322 proofs and burn roughly 40 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
